name: Oliver Reeson
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 1)
description: My practice draws from a number of approaches (including ACT, Focusing Oriented Therapy, and Humanistic Person-Centred work), but I hold a particular interest in Lacanian psychoanalysis and existential approaches. I believe that living is a process. When things are difficult, when we experience emotional suffering or distress that time alone cannot quell, it is often because something is stuck in the process of our experiencing.
